diagnostics.message: When var.iam grants a custom role created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles, google_organization_iam_binding.authoritative must wait for that role to exist. Its role names come from map keys rather than role-resource references, so Terraform can otherwise attempt the binding before role creation.

When additive grants use custom roles created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles, google_organization_iam_member.additive must wait for those roles. The role strings derived from input variables do not establish this ordering.

When the authoritative policy includes custom roles created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles, google_organization_iam_policy.authoritative must wait for their creation. The policy document is built from input role strings and has no dependency on the custom-role resources.
